before_shipping.method: Sequential experiments, no parallel diagnostic load. Shipping has no internal metrics wrapper. One paired run cannot establish statistical causality.

limitations: One sequential pair does not establish causality or eliminate intermittency.
Probe recovery intervals are observation intervals, not continuous freeze durations.
Sampled stack locations and inclusive async-span CPU are not exclusive operation attribution.
Sampling can be delayed by suspension/GIL/scheduling; bounded loss is reported.
No additional PostgreSQL wait-sampling connection in incident mode.
The failed baseline and all prior failed attempts remain failed.
